notes: First ULDM search with a magnetically levitated particle (Meissner-levitated sub-mm magnet). Constrains B-L gauge coupling in narrow mass range (1.10360-1.10485)e-13 eV (26.685-26.715 Hz). Best 90% CL limit g_B-L < 2.98e-21 at m~1.1042e-13 eV. Only three representative points given here spanning the narrow scanned band; full limit closely follows the median MC limit.
